text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stopping by a family restaurant after 
training, I found Light Hello eating a 
burger while looking over notes on the 
table――

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Taste: pass. Presentation: pass. Ease of 
eating: needs improvement—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm... But keeping it all to one plate 
and making it look amazing is a huge 
strength, huh...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, oh? Trainer. Good work today, what 
a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's like eating while working, or 
maybe eating just turns into work 
itself...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
When planning events, I often get the 
chance to work on collaboration menu 
items.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've made a habit of jotting 
down detailed notes whenever a shop or 
dish leaves a great impression...
choice_data_list: You're very dedicated to your work.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, not at all! If anything, it's just 
so fun that I can't help daydreaming about 
it.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah, since you're here, Trainer, may I ask 
for your opinion too? For example――

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Like what you'd want to eat while watching 
the Umamusume race, for instance!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, cheering with everything 
you've got is bound to make you hungry!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
In that case, hearty portion size is 
key... but being able to hold it with one 
hand is a must, and we need that 
collaboration flair too. Which means—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I'm sorry! I totally drifted off 
into my own little world. Bad habit of 
mine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while speaking, Light Hello 
diligently took notes, proving herself as 
hard-working as ever.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I see, sweets really do add that special 
flair, don't they! Fitting for a 
celebratory occasion and all.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
With colorful plating that makes you smile 
just by ordering it――fufu, thanks to that, 
a wonderful idea took shape!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
As a thank-you, let me let you in on a 
little secret. The soft-serve ice cream 
here is actually absolutely delicious!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ate soft-serve ice cream alongside Light 
Hello as she gave a mischievous smile.
